DO NOT PIRATE THIS GAME ! its not worth it. Do not buy it, do not demo it, do not make the mistake to install it. 

IMO this game is where Bioware actually turned from one of the best gaming companies to the shambles it is now. I will elaborate further down below if you want to read more, but know this if you want to just know whats going on.
Their faces are tired.... pronouns are being introduced in a game whose predecessors already had genderfluid races that did GREAT with the gamers ( Asari). The bugs.... dear god ! And the writing....Done by people with serious mental issues ( and I am trying to be very nice here, cause its much worse). 

 Mass effect Andromeda takes all that made Mass effect legendary, and one of the best games ever IMO, and trashes it. There is no choice, or illusion of choice. The characters are poorly written and instead of offering a window into a very complex and mysterious new world, as they should, they seem more like caricatures that aside their role of furthering the games story must also promote the IRL distorted views of whoever wrote them.
 Mass effect Andromeda is not a space RPG its one more of those ♥♥♥♥♥♥ games that try to shove DEI propaganda down ppls throats while not caring about the story or the gameplay at all. 

 Mass Effect did a great job at promoting diversity and inclusion ALL WHILE building an intriguing world inhabited by some very complex characters. I cannot believe the same ppl that worked on the trilogy worked on this one as well. Unless they were all lobotomised ! Because that would explain everything.  
Everything from the protagonist and their father, to the companions and the antagonist is so poorly written. You dont care about them really. They are all edgy for the sake of it. There is no real character in these characters. As I imagine must have been the case with whomever wrote them. 

Then there is the gameplay. Utterly boring !!! Absolutely inconsequential BS that you cant wait to just get through for the next cutscene, that also needs to be sped through as its hilariously bad. Here Bioware took what I consider the worst part of Inquisition and added it to Andromeda. Huge maps with little to do a and a lot of repetitive tedium in them. BORE FESTS made to waste your precious time ! There are kids making mobile games with much better game design abilities than whoever the fck did these maps and the missions within them. It all feels and plays the same. Doesnt matter the class or the weapon. Its all the same crap ! 
 Dont even get me started on the level design and how some things are meant to be played at a later time and the game makes zero effort to hide that from you. Absolutely dumb design. 

At this point, and if you have reached so far down the rant you must be wondering " why TF does did this moron play so many hours of a game he dislikes so much ?" And this is the best part ! I DID NOT !! 

I have maybe played 20 hours of this utterly shambolic attempt at being a game. All the rest of it is my keeping the game open to farm in game currency for the online portion. it was all on autopilot. I was cheating yes. Not to get an advantage no. Not to earn anything particular either. I simply wanted to see how greedy their lootbox design was. And I have an answer for it! 
 If you were to play this game and farm weapons and parts as intended by the devs, it would take you the better part of at least 1000, IRL, hours to begin to play with the upper tier of weapons for the online, PVE, part of the  game !!
 Even though I cheated ,and managed to gain more than 140 million in game currency, in a little more than 120 hours of farming, I still could not unlock all the weapons or all the armour sets. This games online part is so scummy that even by cheating you cannot have everything.  Try to digest this for a moment !!

PS. oh and you have to install EA launcher if you want to play this. it does not launch from Steam !! Cherry on the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ of a ♥♥♥♥ game !
I definitely have some issue with the writing and combat but it's a pretty enjoyable experience <3

Mass Effect Andromeda is a solidly average game that has its share of good aspects, but overall misses the mark on what made the original trilogy great. 

The biggest step up is the combat, which is more dynamic and varied than the original trilogy. The addition of the jump jets makes combat faster and more engaging. There is a large array of fun powers at your disposal, along with a wide variety of weapons, allowing you to create unique builds.

Another thing ME:A does great is the sheer beauty of space and the worlds. It's often hard not to just stop and take in the gorgeous views, whether its the massive dunes of Elaaden, or the icy blizzards on Voeld. I love the massive window on the Tempest, giving you amazing views of every planet and solar system you visit. 

The companions are a mixed bag. A few, like Jaal and Drack, are fine while others like Cora are just mediocre. My problem is that they often feel like discount versions of better companions in the original trilogy. Jaal is just a knockoff of the prothean guy, Drack is Grunt, Vetra is a less interesting Garrus, etc. Having 2 boring human companions is just a waste, one of them should've been replaced by a salarian or something. These companions don't have any truly special moments either. Stuff like the Legion quests or the Mordin plot were fantastic in the trilogy, but Andromeda's companions dont have anything like that. I know I'm comparing 3 games of character development to one, but they still could've done anything more interesting.

The main story is also quite lacking. It's along the same lines as the trilogy where you have to stop the evil aliens from deleting the universe, but the Kett are just not it. Their whole race is so boring honestly, they lack intrigue and mystery, not to mention the main villain is a grey basketball hoop lmao. It was also a huge miss only having one new friendly alien race. The game feels empty without the smaller races present in the trilogy, a few new ones like those could've fleshed out the world better. The game changing choices are also missing, which is especially disappointing considering the game is literally called mass effect. 

As I played, I couldn't help but notice how so much of what Andromeda had to offer was just a diet version of something from the trilogy. The companions are all knockoffs, the nexus is a knockoff citadel, angara are protheans, kett are worse reapers/collectors, remnant tech is worse Geth, Kedara port is a poor mans Omega, etc etc. 

Overall, I don't hate Andromeda but I can't say it was amazing. It's a fine game that has fun combat and gorgeous visuals (minus face animations), while missing the mark on the things that made the original games so special, like the companions and game altering choices. If you're a fan of the trilogy, give Andromeda a try when its on a deep sale, it might scratch your mass effect itch a little bit.
